when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown or cannot be determined whether the value is measured at the screening visit.

name: patient_is_undergoing_dialysis_procedure_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently undergoing dialysis.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently undergoing dialysis.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not undergoing dialysis.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently undergoing dialysis.

name: patient_is_undergoing_dialysis_procedure_now@@intermittent
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the dialysis is intermittent.
when_true: Set to true if the dialysis the patient is currently undergoing is intermittent.
when_false: Set to false if the dialysis is not intermittent.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown or cannot be determined whether the dialysis is intermittent.

name: patient_has_finding_of_disease_condition_finding_now@@would_compromise_safety_or_data_quality_investigator_opinion
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has any disease, condition, or clinical finding that, in the opinion of the investigator, would compromise the safety of the subject or the quality of study data.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has any disease, condition, or clinical finding and, in the opinion of the investigator, this would compromise the safety of the subject or the quality of study data.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently has any disease, condition, or clinical finding but, in the opinion of the investigator, this would not compromise the safety of the subject or the quality of study data.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether, in the opinion of the investigator, the disease, condition, or clinical finding would compromise the safety of the subject or the quality of study data.
